# clerk_users (Data Source)

Lists users for a Clerk application instance via the Platform API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "clerk_users" "example" {
  application_id = clerk_application.example.id
  instance_id    = clerk_application.example.instances[0].instance_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `application_id` (String) The ID of the Clerk application.
- `instance_id` (String) The ID of the Clerk instance.

### Optional

- `limit` (Number) Maximum number of users to return (1-500).
- `offset` (Number) Number of users to skip before returning results.
- `order_by` (String) Order results by a field (e.g. -created_at, +created_at). Defaults to -created_at.
- `query` (String) Filter users by name or email address.

### Read-Only

- `total_count` (Number) Total number of users matching the query.
- `users` (Attributes List) List of users. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))

<a id="nestedatt--users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users`

Read-Only:

- `banned` (Boolean) Whether the user is banned.
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the user was created (RFC3339).
- `email_addresses` (Attributes List) Email addresses associated with the user. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users--email_addresses))
- `first_name` (String) First name of the user.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the user.
- `image_url` (String) URL of the user's profile image.
- `last_name` (String) Last name of the user.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the user was last updated (RFC3339).
- `username` (String) Username of the user.

<a id="nestedatt--users--email_addresses"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users.email_addresses`

Read-Only:

- `email_address` (String) The email address.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the email address.
